account_number.description: Virginia withholding account number: 15 characters starting with 30 (withholding) or 38 (pass-through entity), hyphens removed, e.g. 30 + FEIN + F001

rules: Virginia requires one RS record per employee, with state code 51 in positions 3-4 and 274-275; SSA does not require RS.

Virginia reads the RE record (tax year in positions 3-6, FEIN in 8-16, employer name in 40-96) and, in each RS record, the employee's SSN, name, address, state wages (276-286) and state tax withheld (287-297). Other RS positions are filler to Virginia.

Other EFW2 records may be included in the file; Virginia does not use or validate them. This file is a complete SSA EFW2 file, so it also carries RO and RU records when employees have amounts that go in them.
If an RE record has an error, Virginia does not review its RS records until it is corrected.
Each record except the last is followed by exactly one CR/LF; no delimiter before the first record or inside a record.
Only one form type per file. Virginia recommends naming the file 'W2 REPORT', optionally with the tax year, with no special characters.

RS 248-267 (SSA's State Employer Account Number) is filler in Virginia's W-2 layout; this program puts the Virginia withholding account number from Box 15 there and checks its format, which Virginia's W-2C layout describes as 15 characters beginning with 30 or 38.

source.title: Virginia Tax, Web Upload Guide for W-2s, W-2Cs, and 1099s (Revised 1/2025), Appendix A

ui_quarterly.portal: VEC Web Upload (hosted by Virginia Tax), SUI tax report
ui_quarterly.provisional_note: Built on SSA's generic RS (State) record, not on VEC's own file specification, which is available only inside the VEC employer portal and has been requested. Record set, file name, account number format and the employed-on-the-12th counts may change once VEC's specification is in hand. Do not upload this file to VEC until then.
rules: SSA Pub 42-007, RS record: positions 195-242 and 248-267 'apply to unemployment reporting'. This file uses Reporting Period (197-202, last month and year of the quarter, e.g. 032025), State Quarterly UI Total Wages (203-213), State Quarterly UI Total Taxable Wages (214-224) and State Employer Account Number (248-267, the VEC account).

PROVISIONAL: one RS record per employee with wages in the quarter, after the RA and RE records, then RF. SSA's RW and RT records hold yearly federal W-2 amounts and are left out; RF therefore counts 0 RW records. VEC's specification may ask for a different record set.

PROVISIONAL: income tax fields (274-297), weeks worked (225-226) and hire/separation dates (227-242) are left blank, and the state code at 274-275 is not written, because SSA marks them for income tax reporting or as defined by the state.

PROVISIONAL: SSA's RS record has no field for the number of employees on the payroll on the 12th of each month; VEC asks for these counts on its quarterly report. The counts are worked out and printed, but not written to the file, until VEC's specification shows where they go (likely the state-defined RV record).
Each record except the last is followed by one CR/LF, as in Virginia's W-2 file (PROVISIONAL for VEC).

source.title: SSA Publication 42-007, EFW2, RS (State) record (specs/ssa/efw2_ty2025.txt, efw2_ty2026.txt). VEC Web Upload Guide (July 2026) states VEC accepts EFW2/SSA and ICESA for SUI tax reports; its record layout is not yet in this repository.
